# Fixture Corpus Provenance

This directory is a verbatim copy of the public fixture corpus published
with revision `v0.6.0` of the RP-1 Native Protocol.

```text
source repository   https://github.com/meerita/rp1-spec
revision tag        v0.6.0
commit              fb05ed2e03949e6f45b17afa6acc26dc2a1fcbdb
license             Apache-2.0 OR MIT
```

The files under this directory are copied without modification and are used
as test data only. They are not part of the published crate.

Only the fixture files (`*.json`) and the corpus `README.md` are copied.
The specification documents that define the rules the fixtures exercise
remain in the source repository.
